description: Test whether the hydrophobic moment at position 331-338 is conserved across lycopene cyclases above a background of all 8-residue windows
code:
import os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
OUT=os.getcwd(); exec(open(os.path.join(OUT,'crty_lib.py')).read(), globals())
R=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'moment_conservation.csv'))
H=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,'lycopene_cyclase_homologs.json')))
q=H['P21687']['seq']
WIN={'helix 331-338':(331,338),'helix 311-321':(311,321),'C-term 353-372':(353,372),
     'helix 95-104':(95,104),'core 140-150':(140,150),'core 236-246':(236,246)}
qv={lab:hyd_moment(q[lo-1:hi])[0] for lab,(lo,hi) in WIN.items()}
# null: every 8-residue window of every bacterial homologue
null=[]
for k,v in H.items():
    if v['lineage'] and v['lineage'][0]=='Bacteria':
        s=v['seq']
        for i in range(0,len(s)-8,17): null.append(hyd_moment(s[i:i+8])[0])
null=np.array(null); print('null windows n=%d  mean muH %.3f  sd %.3f  95th pct %.3f'%(len(null),null.mean(),null.std(),np.percentile(null,95)))
out=[]
for lab in WIN:
    for grp in ['bacteria','eukaryote']:
        v=R.loc[R.grp==grp,lab].dropna().values
        out.append(dict(region=lab,group=grp,n=len(v),CrtY_muH=round(qv[lab],3),
                        median=round(float(np.median(v)),3),mean=round(float(v.mean()),3),
                        sd=round(float(v.std()),3),
                        frac_above_null95=round(float((v>np.percentile(null,95)).mean()),3),
                        p_vs_null=float(stats.mannwhitneyu(v,null,alternative='greater').pvalue)))
T=pd.DataFrame(out); T.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'moment_conservation_stats.csv'),index=False)
pd.set_option('display.width',220); print(T.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
a=ax[0]
labs=['helix 331-338','helix 311-321','C-term 353-372','helix 95-104','core 140-150','core 236-246']
dataB=[R.loc[R.grp=='bacteria',l].dropna().values for l in labs]
bp=a.boxplot(dataB,labels=[l.replace(' ','\n') for l in labs],patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for p,l in zip(bp['boxes'],labs): p.set_facecolor('#27ae60' if l=='helix 331-338' else '#bdc3c7')
a.axhline(np.percentile(null,95),ls='--',color='#c0392b',lw=1)
a.text(5.4,np.percentile(null,95)+0.02,'95th pct of all 8-mers',fontsize=7,color='#c0392b')
for i,l in enumerate(labs,1): a.plot(i,qv[l],'k*',ms=11,zorder=5)
a.set_ylabel('hydrophobic moment per residue'); a.tick_params(labelsize=7.5)
a.set_title('A. 199 bacterial lycopene cyclases: the region aligned to 331-338\nkeeps a high moment, stars mark P. ananatis CrtY',fontsize=9)
a=ax[1]
for grp,c in [('bacteria','#27ae60'),('eukaryote','#8e44ad')]:
    v=R.loc[R.grp==grp,'helix 331-338'].dropna().values
    a.hist(v,bins=22,alpha=.6,color=c,label='%s (n=%d)'%(grp,len(v)),density=True)
a.hist(null,bins=40,histtype='step',color='k',density=True,label='all 8-mers (null)')
a.axvline(qv['helix 331-338'],color='#c0392b',lw=2,label='CrtY WRVMQRFY = %.2f'%qv['helix 331-338'])
a.set_xlabel('hydrophobic moment per residue of the 331-338 equivalent'); a.set_ylabel('density')
a.legend(fontsize=7.5)
a.set_title('B. Amphipathicity at this position is kept in bacteria\nand lost in the fused plant and fungal enzymes',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
